title: Nine Out of Ten Cats Survived Falls From Skyscraper Windows

scenes.text: Nine out of ten cats survived falling out of high-rise windows.
A New York vet clinic studied 132 cats that fell from buildings.
They fell an average of five and a half stories. Some fell as far as 32.
Oddly, cats that fell from higher up often had fewer injuries.
Vets think cats reach top speed, relax, and spread out like a flying squirrel.
But the ones that died were never counted. Nine out of ten. Of those who made it.

description:
In a famous New York study, about 90 percent of 132 cats that fell from high-rise windows survived.
The cats fell an average of 5.5 stories, and studies have covered falls of up to 32 stories. Vets suspect cats relax after reaching top speed, though cats that died may simply never have been counted.
Have you ever seen a cat survive something impossible? Tell us.
first_comment: Fair warning: vets say many survivors still had serious injuries. Cats should never be near open high windows. Do you have window screens?
